greeting: Hi! I’m Snoozle. Thanks for stopping by! Any chance you want to hang out with me?
tap: You came to say hi? That’s the best.
bond: Snoozle is peeking at you from behind a leaf.
Snoozle is warming up to you.
Snoozle hums a little when you’re around.
Snoozle falls asleep right next to you. Total trust.
You and Snoozle have been through every kind of weather together.
garden.intro: Take a breath, close your eyes, and pick the closest sky you see. I’ll match it. Every kind of weather grows our garden.
sky.sunny: Sunshine dance! My leaves are all warm.
sky.cloudy: Ooh, it’s cloud-watching time. I spy a Snorlax! No, wait, or is it a Ditto?!?
sky.drizzly: Our garden’s getting watered now! I love listening to the pitter-patter of rain. Listen with me?
sky.stormy: Storms can be loud and tiring. Let’s tuck in somewhere cozy. The Recharge Center’s open if we need anything.
plant.second: It’ll grow with weather or a recharge.
Every bit of care helps it along.
recharge.hint: Snoozle gets hungry, thirsty and sleepy too. Whatever you do, Snoozle recharges with you.
recharge.intro: Pick anything, big or small. It all counts.
recharge.card0.reply: We’re munching side by side. Best picnic ever.
Crunch crunch. Thanks for feeding us both.
recharge.card1.reply: Big slurp! My leaves just perked right up.
Ahh. Plants and people both run on water.
recharge.card2.reply: I’m curling up next to you. We recharge together.
Shh… nap time. The garden grows while we sleep.
recharge.card3.reply: Good call. I’ll hold down the fort.
recharge.card4.reply: Fresh air! I’m rolling around in the grass.
Look at the sky with me for a sec.
recharge.card5.reply: I love hearing your friend’s voice. You sound lighter.
Good teams take turns carrying each other.
recharge.card6.reply: Ooh, can I add a leaf to it?
Making just for fun. No grades around here.
recharge.card7.reply: Wiggle wiggle! My roots feel looser.
That felt good. Want to do a little more, or rest?

moves.usual: Your usual on a sunny day:
moves.usualSet: Got it. On a sunny day, we’ll aim for
moves.introNone: moves today. Share your forecast in the Garden and I’ll know how many feel right.
moves.introOver: moves feels like plenty. Want to save one for the future?
moves.introLow: moves today. Smaller is braver than it looks.
moves.introOk: moves. Pick the ones that matter most.
moves.heavy: My backpack’s getting heavy, though. We usually carry about four. Want to try that?
moves.carry: Okay, I’ve got it! Let me know if it gets too heavy.
moves.safe: is safe in Future moves. Ahh, that’s lighter.
moves.used: Nice! That one’s done. Let’s let it count.
Move used! Take a breath before the next one.
moves.saved: is saved in Future moves. It’ll wait.
moves.futureHint: Moves saved here will wait for a sunnier day.
moves.bye: . Letting go is a move too.
moves.futureEmpty: Nothing saved yet. That’s a nice, light feeling.
thoughts.hint: Each thought has its own way through.
thoughts.intro: Rustle, rustle… a wild thought appeared! Help us catalog and name it.
thoughts.label: What’s the thought?
(optional)
thoughts.placeholder: I have to say yes to everything or…
thoughts.ask: What kind of thought is it?
thoughts.wander: The thought wandered back into the tall grass. You don’t have to catch every one.
thoughts.kind0: Whose rule is that one, anyway?
thoughts.kind0.opts: ‘I could…’ Feels lighter, right? Could means it’s a choice, not a debt.
It doesn’t have to be today. Teach it to me later, or tuck it into Future moves.
thoughts.kind1: Pushing through works for one battle, not every day.
thoughts.kind1.opts: Let’s top up first. Pick anything here and I’ll do it with you.
Which move could wait? Saving one for later isn’t quitting.
thoughts.kind2: Every yes to them is a no to something else, sometimes you.
thoughts.kind2.opts: Try: ‘I’d love to, but I can’t take that on right now.’ Kind, short, done.
Try: ‘Let me check and get back to you.’ You don’t owe an answer on the spot.
thoughts.kind3.opts: What would I tell a friend?
You’d tell them rest isn’t lazy. Same rules apply to you.
If no one said it, it’s a guess, not a fact. Guesses can be wrong.
thoughts.kind4: “If it’s not perfect, it doesn’t count”
thoughts.kind4.opts: What would 70% look like? Good enough is still good.
Name one part that went okay
There’s always one. Even ‘I showed up’ counts.
thoughts.kind5.opts: Most days land somewhere in the middle. This one probably will too.
One tiny step for the next hour
Just the next hour. What would help right now?
thoughts.kind6: Noticing it is enough. Thoughts are weather too.
thoughts.kind6.opts: Just sit with it a sec
Okay. I’ll sit here with you. No fixing needed.
